title: French Semolina Madeleine Cake
description: A traditional French cake made with semolina flour, perfect for a warm breakfast or snack. This recipe yields a moist and flavorful madeleine cake with a delicate crumb.
instructions: Grease a madeleine pan and dust it with confectioners' sugar.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the semolina flour, all-purpose flour, granulated sugar, and salt.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and melted butter.
Add the milk and vanilla extract to the egg mixture and whisk until smooth.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and whisk until combined.
Pour the batter into the prepared madeleine pan and smooth the top.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until the edges are golden brown.
Remove the cake from the oven and let it cool in the pan for 5 minutes.
Transfer the cake to a wire rack to cool completely.
Dust the cake with confectioners' sugar before serving.
